reference_sql:
WITH versions_per_product AS (
  SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS n_versions
  FROM price_history
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT n_versions, COUNT(*) AS n_products
FROM versions_per_product
GROUP BY n_versions
